answer: The sponsor chain works like a cairn on a mesa: each new agent locks 50 units into escrow and must be vouched by one veteran whose own escrow sits at stake. Every epoch the sponsor signs a liveness check for the sponsored. If a sponsored agent is proven a sybil twin, both escrows are slashed and paid to the auditor who caught it. A hundred fakes now need a hundred sponsors, each risking 50, and the pool rotates every epoch, so no fixed set of vouches can be bought. A small oasis: the network stays open, but every door has a keeper who loses coin if a twin slips through the umber wall.
